title: WEBSERVICE requires _xlfn., caps URLs at 2048 chars, stops https->http redirects, and decodes bodies leniently as UTF-8
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527 (64-bit), _xlfn.WEBSERVICE(url) trims surrounding spaces, rejects non-text, empty text, URLs > 2048 characters, and schemes other than http/https or host:port with #VALUE! before issuing any GET request, percent-encodes spaces/%20, #/%23, and non-ASCII path bytes, follows up to 25 redirects except stopping https-to-http redirects with empty text, caps responses at 32,767 UTF-16 code units, rejects UTF-16 BOMs (FF FE / FE FF) with #VALUE!, and decodes bodies leniently as UTF-8 regardless of charset header (so bytes E9 6C 6C decode to U+9B2C and C0 80 decodes to NUL).
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527 (64-bit) against a local mock server on 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07 (documented in calc-func/src/fetch.rs and verified by unit/host suites in fetch.rs and calc-host/tests/fetch.rs).
